editorial.thesis: A motor-trade-and-office-led city of about 1.1 million. Its retail is heavy on apparel, footwear & jewellery and banks & atms, and thin on pharmacy & health retail and restaurants & fast food — and 25% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 82% of Chennai's. 31.8 chain outlets per lakh residents against 38.86 in Chennai; 32 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Apollo Pharmacy 86, Reliance Trends 44, Bata 30.

The mapped economy leans to automotive. Shares of all mapped places: automotive 5.2% (Chennai 3.1%); malls & department stores 0.7% (Chennai 0.5%); healthcare 7.3% (Chennai 9.6%); leisure & entertainment 2.9% (Chennai 3.7%). Raw counts would mislead because Chennai is mapped more completely (64,463 places against 19,158), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 6 zones hold 25% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Kuniamuthur alone has about 49,000 residents and 33 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Chennai. 50% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Chennai 37%). The largest cores are Rathinasabapathy Puram (1,261 places) and Bazaar · Sukrawarpettai (999).

The widest brand gaps against Chennai. Apollo Pharmacy 86 outlets vs 281; MedPlus 11 outlets vs 160; Domino's 18 outlets vs 109. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 8 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Chennai, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Ganapathy and Gandhimaanagar are the largest zones by residents (96,000 and 68,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 50% of all commercial places, and Rathinasabapathy Puram alone lists 1,261.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Bazaar · Sukrawarpettai holds 34 of the 344 tracked chain outlets, and Gandhimaanagar adds 31.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Gandhimaanagar and Gandhipuram · Tatabad lead on education places (144 and 108, with 61 and 64 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Kuniamuthur and Vadavalli · Pappanaickenpudur. The blue cores include Rathinasabapathy Puram.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (64,463 places in Chennai against 19,158 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Chennai; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Chennai, Coimbatore's mapped places over-index on automotive (5.2% vs 3.1%), malls & department stores (0.7% vs 0.5%), offices (15.1% vs 12.9%) and under-index on healthcare (7.3% vs 9.6%), leisure & entertainment (2.9% vs 3.7%), food & beverage (6.6% vs 7.5%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 344 outlets of 32 tracked national brands within 8 km — 31.8 per lakh residents against Chennai's 38.86 (1445 outlets of 43 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Chennai are Apollo Pharmacy (86 vs 281); MedPlus (11 vs 160); Domino's (18 vs 109). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Chennai's, so low means thin by Chennai's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 8 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Coimbatore's age mix against Chennai: children (0–14) 19.2% vs 20.8%, 15–24 15.7% vs 17.3%, working age 53.8% vs 52.2%, 60+ 11.3% vs 9.7%. Under-25s are 35% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 4.5% of mapped places against 5.2% in Chennai — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 18 (Chennai 109), KFC 16 (Chennai 62), Pizza Hut 11 (Chennai 54), McDonald's 5 (Chennai 22). No mapped outlet in either city: Biryani By Kilo, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.0% of mapped places against 2.2% in Chennai, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 16 (Chennai 87), Starbucks 4 (Chennai 25). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Blue Tokai.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.8% of mapped places against 0.8% in Chennai, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 6 (Chennai 23), Cream Stone 2 (Chennai 4). No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 2.0% of mapped places against 2.0% in Chennai, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 10 (Chennai 31), DMart 4 (Chennai 7), Spencer's 3 (Chennai 26), Big Bazaar 2 (Chennai 6).
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.1% of mapped places against 1.4% in Chennai — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 86 (Chennai 281), MedPlus 11 (Chennai 160). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 6.1% of mapped places against 5.5% in Chennai — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Trends 44 (Chennai 130), Bata 30 (Chennai 65), Raymond 18 (Chennai 47), Titan 12 (Chennai 45).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 8.1% of mapped places against 7.4% in Chennai, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 2.6% of mapped places against 3.0% in Chennai — below its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.7% of mapped places against 4.0% in Chennai, so the mix is level.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
